subject: RETURN statement
notes: RULE (cite.py --check 14.9.34.4 'is undefined at the completion of the execution of the RETURN statement' -> OK, 14.9.34.4 rule 2). This is a PERMISSION, not an obligation: with more than one record description, whatever lies outside the current record's range is undefined, so any deterministic content conforms. CODE (read, not assumed): BindReturn:255-260 deliberately resolves the record area through file.AreaRecord - the LARGEST record's view (13.4.2) - rather than Records[0], so a multi-01 SD is not truncated; EmitReturn:167 calls SequentialIoEmitter.EmitImageInto(rt.RecordArea, tmp), which writes CobolString.Store(image, record.ImageWidth). CobolString.Store(value, width, justifiedRight=false, pad=' ') space-fills, so the bytes outside the returned record are deterministically SPACES - a documented refinement of 'undefined'. The secondary 01s of a multi-01 SD are synthesized REDEFINES over that same area (9.1.2), so they read the same image. Nothing here can contradict a rule whose content is a grant of undefinedness.
